dialogue.content: こんにちは、本日はよろしくお願いいたします。お時間になりましたら、始めさせていただきます。
dialogue.English: Hello, thank you for being here today. We will begin at the scheduled time.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。本日はご相談ありがとうございます。はじめにあなたの年齢、性別をお聞かせ頂けますか？
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm your counselor. Thank you for consulting with me today. To begin, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 60代男性です
dialogue.English: I'm a man in my 60s.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: ラインコのことで悩んでいます
dialogue.English: I'm having some trouble with Rainco.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、もう少し詳しく教えて頂けますか？どのような、悩みでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Could you please tell me a little more about it? What kind of trouble are you having?

dialogue.content: カウンセラー役でやってもモロクソ言われて返ってきて、なんか嫌になってしまいます
dialogue.English: When I play the counselor role, I just get harsh criticism back, and it's starting to make me hate it.

dialogue.content: もうやめた方がいいんですかね？
dialogue.English: I'm wondering if I should just quit.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、心ない言葉を掛けられて不快な思いをされたのですね。辞めたいくらい嫌な気持ちになられたのですね。どんな、言葉をかけられたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see, so you've been subjected to some thoughtless comments that made you feel very uncomfortable. It's made you feel so bad that you're even thinking about quitting. What kind of things were said to you?

dialogue.content: こんなことも出来てないとか
dialogue.English: Things like, "You can’t even do this."

dialogue.content: 自分でも出来てないことはわかってるんですが、
dialogue.English: I know that I'm not doing it well, but...

dialogue.content: え～そんな言葉を…らいんこ上で私も言われたら同じ気持ちになります。
dialogue.English: Oh, to say something like that... If someone said that to me on Rainco, I would feel the same way.

dialogue.content: もちろん、みんな出来るようになるためのシステムです。初めは出来なくて当然です。
dialogue.English: Of course, the system is designed to help everyone improve. It's natural not to be able to do it well at first.

dialogue.content: でもプロの方と初心者混ざってますよね？
dialogue.English: But there are professionals and beginners mixed together, aren't there?

dialogue.content: えっ　初耳でした　そうなんですね‥。
dialogue.English: Oh, that's the first I've heard of that. Is that so?

dialogue.content: はい、先生にも聞きました。自分はくじ運が悪いのか何時もプロの方が相談に来るんです
dialogue.English: Yes, I asked the instructor, too. I don't know if it's just bad luck, but I always get a professional as the client.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか‥私も、25点を叩き出しましたので、その時は一ヶ月らいんこにこれませんでした。
dialogue.English: I see... I once got a score of 25, and after that, I couldn't bring myself to come on Rainko for a month.

dialogue.content: 自分も同じです、28点を叩き出しました、みんな同じ状況なのででしょうか？
dialogue.English: Same here—I got a 28. Is everyone in the same situation?

dialogue.content: はい、おなじですよ。安心してください。私は平均点は低くても、その時の課題を持って達成することにシフトを変えることにしました。
dialogue.English: Yes, we are. Please don't worry. Even if my average score is low, I've decided to shift my focus to setting a specific goal for each session and achieving that.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね！前向きですね！
dialogue.English: I see! That's a very positive way to look at it!

dialogue.content: 言われたばかりの大吉さんは、少し時間が必要かもしれませんが、ゆっくりと進んでみませんか？
dialogue.English: Daikichi-san, since this just happened to you, you might need a little time, but how about we try to move forward slowly?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。何か自分は老後在宅でできる仕事をしたいと思って来たんですよ
dialogue.English: Thank you. You know, I came here because I want to find a job I can do from home in my old age.

dialogue.content: 別にカウンセラーが簡単な仕事だとは思ってませんが、何か下に書いてあるのを見ると萎えてきます
dialogue.English: It's not that I think being a counselor is an easy job, but when I see the feedback comments, it's just so discouraging.

dialogue.content: そんな素敵な夢をお持ちなんですね。私も同じです。萎えます。
dialogue.English: That's a wonderful dream to have. I feel the same way. It is discouraging.

dialogue.content: カウンセラーさんは、下に書いてあるのを平均が低く又そのコメント読んだ時どうしてますか？
dialogue.English: When you get a low average score and read the comments, what do you do?

dialogue.content: 自分は立ち直れそうにないので今回相談させてもらいにきました
dialogue.English: I don't think I can recover on my own, which is why I came to talk to you today.

dialogue.content: 25点の時は、コメントさえ無しでした。最近は、怖くて読めません。でもしっかりとその時の目標を立てて望んでいます。今日は、しっかりと共感と受容です。
dialogue.English: That time I got 25 points, there weren't even any comments. Lately, I'm too scared to read them. But I make sure to set a clear goal for each session. For today, it's solid empathy and acceptance.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、立ち直れるように一緒に考えて行けたらと思っております。
dialogue.English: I see. I hope we can think together about how you can recover from this.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、ありがとうございます。みんな色々悔しい思いをしてるんだとわかり安心しました
dialogue.English: I see, thank you. I feel relieved knowing that everyone else is also going through frustrating experiences.

dialogue.content: それは、良かったです。でもコメントはリスニングトレーニングと同じで、良かったところを伝え、次に改善出来そうなことを伝えるのが望ましいと私は思っていますが、いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. However, I believe that for comments, just like in listening training, it's best to first point out what was good and then suggest things that could be improved. What do you think?

dialogue.content: ええ、自分もそのように考えています。でも現実は厳しくて、これ出来てない、あれ出来てない、で自分が提案した目標にはそんなことできるわけがない
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too. But the reality is harsh. It's just, "You didn't do this, you didn't do that," and for the goal I proposed, "There's no way you can do that."

dialogue.content: 最後にいい勉強になりました
dialogue.English: And at the end, "It was a good learning experience."

dialogue.content: 自分のカウンセリングに役立てます
dialogue.English: "I'll use this for my own counseling."

dialogue.content: とこんな感じなんです。
dialogue.English: That’s what it’s like.

dialogue.content: 少し前向きな気持ちに変わってきましたね。
dialogue.English: It sounds like your feelings have shifted to be a bit more positive.

dialogue.content: 私も勉強になります。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: This is a learning experience for me too. Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: らいんこは、無理せずゆっくり期限までに達成できるといいですね。
dialogue.English: With Rainco, it would be nice if you could proceed at an easy pace and meet the deadline without overexerting yourself.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: You're right.

dialogue.content: お辛い感情は、今はどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How are you feeling now about those painful emotions?

dialogue.content: だいぶ落ち着きましたが、まだ迷ってます。このままやるかどうか
dialogue.English: I've calmed down quite a bit, but I'm still unsure whether I should continue with this or not.

dialogue.content: うんうん、それは良かったでもでも辞めてしまいたいくらい、本当に辛かったのですね。
dialogue.English: Mhm, I'm glad to hear that, but it must have been truly painful, enough to make you want to quit.

dialogue.content: あと、何回残っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How many more sessions do you have left?

dialogue.content: ええ、顔が見えないし、言われっぱなしがなんとも言えない気分になります
dialogue.English: Yes, and since you can't see their face, being on the receiving end of constant criticism feels indescribably awful.

dialogue.content: まだまだ残ってます。
dialogue.English: I still have a lot left.

dialogue.content: 言い返しが、出来ませんものね。そうですか、回数がまだあるならそう思うのも無理はありません。期日は何月まで残っているのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: You can't talk back, can you. I see. If you still have many sessions left, it's understandable that you feel that way. What month is your deadline?

dialogue.content: 後1ヶ月はあります
dialogue.English: I have about one month left.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、恥ずかしながら‥私もあと、一ヶ月有りますが、やっと半分をこなしたところで前途多難です。
dialogue.English: I see. It's a bit embarrassing to admit, but I also have one month left, and I've only just managed to get through half of it. It feels like a long road ahead.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、でも前向きに取り組まれて凄いですね
dialogue.English: Is that so? But it's amazing that you're tackling it so positively.

dialogue.content: 前向きになるまでは、本当に大変でしたので、大吉さんのお気持ちは痛いほど分かります。
dialogue.English: It was really hard for me to become positive, so I understand your feelings, Daikichi-san, painfully well.

dialogue.content: 泣けてきます
dialogue.English: That makes me want to cry.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、同じ気持ち味わいましたので、ここからやろうと思うまで時間が必要だと感じます。
dialogue.English: I know. I've felt the same way, so I think it takes time to get to a point where you feel ready to try again.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、時が解決してくれますか？
dialogue.English: I see. Do you think time will solve it?

dialogue.content: 休んでいる間に、自分と向き合いました。辞めるのは簡単、さて本当に辞めたいのか、それともカウンセラーになりたいのか‥ととことん自分と向き合いました
dialogue.English: While I took a break, I really confronted myself. Quitting is easy, so I thoroughly questioned myself: do I truly want to quit, or do I want to become a counselor?

dialogue.content: そうなんですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: やると決め、一ヶ月ぶりにらいんこに入り、その時のお相手がとても良い方で、点数の高い低いではないことに、気付きました
dialogue.English: I decided to continue, and when I logged into Rainko for the first time in a month, my partner for that session was a very kind person. That's when I realized it's not about whether the score is high or low.

dialogue.content: そういう方と出会えると救われますよね、自分は何時も叩き台にされてる感じで、
dialogue.English: Meeting someone like that can really be a saving grace, can't it? I always feel like I'm just being used as a punching bag.

dialogue.content: たまりません
dialogue.English: It's unbearable.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねもし、よろしけれ次、わたしとプレーしてみませんか？少し自信を持つことが必要に思うのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. If you'd like, would you be willing to do the next session with me? I feel it might be necessary for you to regain a little confidence. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 素敵な提案ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: That's a wonderful suggestion. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 明日の同じ時間はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about the same time tomorrow?

dialogue.content: はい、ぜひお願いします。自分はカウンセラー役で申し込みますね
dialogue.English: Yes, I would love that. I'll sign up for the counselor role.

dialogue.content: でもラインコでもまだ自分の気持ちわかってくれる人がいるとわかってホッとしました
dialogue.English: But I'm relieved to know that there are still people on Rainco who can understand how I feel.

dialogue.content: 承知いたしました。せっかく、同じ学びをする仲間です。楽しく学び続けましょう。今後ともよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Understood. We're colleagues learning the same thing, after all. Let's continue to learn in an enjoyable way. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。とりあえず、明日頑張って入ってみます。少し不安ですが、
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. For now, I'll do my best to log in tomorrow. I'm still a little anxious, though.

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です。明日の目標はどうしますか？教えていただけたら幸いです。
dialogue.English: It’s all right. What shall we set as your goal for tomorrow? I’d appreciate it if you could let me know.

dialogue.content: はい、解決しようとしすぎる。共感の言葉が少ないと言われたので共感の言葉を頑張ります
dialogue.English: Yes. I was told I try too hard to solve the problem and that I don't use enough words of empathy, so I will focus on using words of empathy.

dialogue.content: 少し元気出ました。
dialogue.English: I feel a bit more encouraged.

dialogue.content: カウンセリングには良いも悪いも無い。その時の自分の最善の対応をする事だと思うのです。不安もまとめて、受止めます。傷つく言葉は使いませんので安心してくださいね。
dialogue.English: There's no right or wrong in counseling. I believe it's about doing your best in that moment. I will accept your anxiety and all. Please rest assured, I won't use any hurtful words.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you. I look forward to it.

dialogue.content: はい、共感の言葉ですね。そろそろ、お時間とになりました。本日は沢山の思いを聞かせていただきありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Understood, words of empathy. It looks like our time is about up. Thank you for sharing so much with me today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイ終了させていただきます失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: We'll now conclude the role-play. Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you very much.
